fixtures.applicability_scope: An ordinary Int-returning same-name method outside a loop is not a Boolean protocol request.

fixtures.applicability_scope: A plain object-valued property does not require getValue.

fixtures.boundary_scope: Delegated writes may execute observers and are excluded rather than treated as dead ordinary-local writes.
